## Summary

Keep generated dtplyr Parent/Total share membership independent of caller root bindings. Closes #1203.

```diff
 generated share membership
- root lookup of `%in%`
+ base::`%in%` on dtplyr
  bare `%in%` for SQL translation
  caller-written expressions keep caller lookup
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** On main `82d0f300`, a late raising root `%in%` broke collection; an inverted counting callback made all shares one. Two-stage Parent selection also used the callback and returned incorrect denominators.
  **After:** Both regression slices passed after their respective fixes. Public-seam controls cover preexisting/late counting and raising callbacks, fixed and missing keys, visible columns, immutable input, lazy construction, caller lookup, and native/portable DuckDB.
- Verification: [full d58de164 and source ec26827a; all mandatory checks passed](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1208#issuecomment-6619158358). Full check: 213 test files, 0 ERROR/WARNING/NOTE. Adopted measured registration of the new test; no modeled speedup claimed.
- Review: [Standards 0 / Spec 0 at ec26827a](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1208#issuecomment-6619175419).

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert the expression-generation change and its regression tests.

**Blast Radius:** shares

Touches generated contextual-share membership and its private operator argument; public signatures are unchanged.
